name: MUKUND SASIKUMAR
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A consistent baseliner with strong movement and defensive capabilities, effective on hard and clay courts.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #229 (October 2019).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ATP Challenger & ITF Titles: Winner of multiple ITF Futures titles and finalist in ATP Challenger events.
Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India in Davis Cup ties, playing crucial matches for the national team.
Other Highlights: Competes regularly on the ATP Challenger circuit, aiming for a breakthrough into the ATP Tour.
